answer: Pay a bounty from the fake's own stake to anyone who proves an identity fake. Each identity must lock a refundable deposit before it can earn, and that deposit is the anchor tying the identity to real cost. A proven fake loses its deposit, which becomes the bounty, so an attacker cannot hide one sparrow among thousands of clones: every extra fake multiplies the attacker's exposure instead of its reward. Honest agents keep their deposit and gain standing, while the nectar of easy rewards dries up for fraud, because creating fakes now funds the very people who expose them.
